Medical recors and certificate.question: 1) Medical certificates are classified as:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Medical certificates are written documents and are therefore documentary evidence. Fitness, illness, birth and death certificates are examples.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 2) Fitness certificate is a type of:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Fitness certificate is included under medical certificates. It may be used for legal, employment or administrative purposes.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 3) Illness certificate is best classified as:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Illness certificate documents a patient’s illness. It is a form of medical certificate and documentary evidence.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 4) Birth certificate is an example of:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Birth certificate is listed among medical certificates. It documents birth-related information and has legal importance.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 5) Death certificate is a:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Death certificate is a medical certificate issued by a doctor when proper conditions are fulfilled. It must be authentic and correctly completed.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 6) Age certificate is usually issued after:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Age certificate is issued after clinical and radiological assessment. It is often used for legal or school purposes.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 7) Age certificate is commonly used for:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Age certificate is useful where legal age or school admission/record age is needed. It should be based on proper examination.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 8) Injury report is mainly used in:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Injury report is a medico-legal report used in assault, accidents and violence. It includes physical findings and opinion on weapon or nature of injury.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 9) Injury report includes opinion on:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Injury report records physical findings and medico-legal opinion. Opinion may include nature of injury and possible weapon.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 10) Postmortem report records:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Postmortem report records autopsy findings. It may include opinion about cause and time of death.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 11) Postmortem report usually gives opinion on:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: A postmortem report includes findings during autopsy and opinion regarding cause and time of death. It has medico-legal value.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 12) Sexual assault report includes:
Medical recors and certificate.option1: General examination, genital examination and forensic evidence
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Sexual assault report contains general and genital examination findings. It also includes forensic evidence collection and documentation.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 13) Toxicology report is mainly used in:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Toxicology report is used in suspected poisoning. It includes clinical examination and laboratory findings.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 14) Toxicology report includes:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Toxicology report combines clinical findings with lab results. It helps confirm or exclude poisoning.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 15) Name, age, sex, address and occupation in a medico-legal report are:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Demographic information includes name, age, sex, address and occupation. It identifies the examined person.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 16) Brief history of incident in a medico-legal report comes under:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: The history section records brief history of incident or complaint. It provides context for examination findings.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 17) General and local examination findings are recorded under:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Medico-legal reports should contain general and local examination findings. These findings form the factual medical basis of the report.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 18) Doctor’s medico-legal conclusion is written as:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Opinion is the doctor’s medico-legal interpretation based on history and examination. It should be clear, scientific and limited to medical facts.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 19) Identification marks in a medico-legal report are used for:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Identification marks help confirm the identity of the examined person. They are important in medico-legal documentation.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 20) Signature, seal, date and designation of doctor represent:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Authentication validates the medico-legal report. Signature, seal, date and designation prove responsibility and official status.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 21) Proper handling and transfer of samples/documents is called:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Chain of custody means proper handling and transfer of samples or documents. It preserves legal reliability of evidence.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 22) Medico-legal reports are important because they are used as:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Medico-legal reports are used as medical evidence in the criminal justice system. Accuracy and authenticity are essential.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 23) A death certificate may be issued when death is due to:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: A doctor may issue a death certificate when death is due to natural causes and the cause is known.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 24) For issuing death certificate, the cause of death should be:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Death certificate should be issued only when the doctor knows the cause of death. Unknown or suspicious deaths need medico-legal handling.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 25) The doctor issuing death certificate should have attended the patient during:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: The doctor should have attended the patient during the last illness. This helps ensure the cause of death is known and reliable.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 26) Before issuing a death certificate, the doctor should be satisfied about:
Medical recors and certificate.option4: Identity of deceased and cause of death
Medical recors and certificate.exp: The doctor must be satisfied about the identity of the deceased and cause of death. Wrong certification has medico-legal consequences.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 27) In suspicious death, the doctor should issue:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: In suspicious death, ordinary death certificate should not be issued. The case should be treated as medico-legal.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 28) In accidental death, death certificate should be:
Medical recors and certificate.option3: Not issued as natural death certificate
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Accidental death is an unnatural death. It needs medico-legal reporting rather than routine natural death certification.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 29) In suicidal death, the proper approach is:
Medical recors and certificate.option4: Do not issue ordinary death certificate
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Suicidal death is an unnatural death. The doctor should not issue ordinary death certificate as natural death.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 30) In homicidal death, ordinary death certificate should be:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Homicidal death is medico-legal. Ordinary death certificate should not be issued as natural death.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 31) In suspected poisoning, death certificate should be:
Medical recors and certificate.option3: Not issued as ordinary natural death certificate
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Poisoning is a medico-legal situation. Death certificate should not be issued as ordinary natural death certificate.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 32) Referral certificate is mainly concerned with:
Medical recors and certificate.option2: Transfer of patient care to another facility or doctor
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Referral certificate documents transfer of care. It should contain relevant clinical information and reason for referral.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 33) Discharge certificate is mainly issued when:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: Discharge certificate summarizes hospital treatment and advice. It is an important medical record for continuity of care.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 34) Death certificate should be prepared authentically as per:
Medical recors and certificate.exp: The syllabus states death certificate should be prepared properly and authentically as per ICD-10. ICD-10 helps standardize cause-of-death recording.

Medical recors and certificate.question: 35) The best complete medico-legal report should contain:
Medical recors and certificate.option1: Demography, history, findings, opinion and authentication
Medical recors and certificate.option3: Patient's Name, diagnosis, treatment & doctor’s signature
Medical recors and certificate.exp: A proper medico-legal report includes identity details, history, examination findings, opinion and authentication. Chain of custody is also important when samples are involved.
